lines.4: 「Ahhh! It's a little bitter, but it's good!」
lines.5: 「You make great tea. You'll be a fine office lady someday!」
lines.9: For some reason, I was the one embarrassed.
lines.10: 「Now I understand how a parent feels teaching a child manners.」
lines.11: 「Yeah. If you don't educate them, they embarrass you in places like this.」
lines.12: 「What an impressive way to drink. Keep it coming.」
lines.13: The Princess and Sato did not seem very bothered.
lines.14: Maybe I was worrying too much.
lines.15: Otome also looked ready to comment on Crab's manners, but let it pass.
